label.rowIndexesDescription: Specify row ranges for each split using comma-separated values or ranges (e.g. 0-100, 200).
label.selectDatasetColumns: Indicate which columns of the dataset will be used as input and output.
label.selectDatasetTitle: Select a dataset for the selected task
label.selectHowToDivideDataset: Select how to divide the dataset into training, validation and test subsets.
label.numFoldsDescription: Number of folds to use for cross-validation. A higher number of folds can improve the stability of the evaluation, but increases the processing time. Must be an integer greater than 1.
label.numRepeatsDescription: Number of times to repeat the cross-validation process. A higher value provides more precise results but requires more training time. Must be an integer greater than 1.
label.selectInputOutputColumnsDescription: Select column names from the lists.
label.shuffleDescription: Determines whether the data will be shuffled when defining the sets or not. It must be true to shuffle the data, otherwise false.
label.splitsDescription: Proportion of data assigned to each subset. Values must be between 0 and 1 and sum to 1.
label.stratifyDescription: Defines whether the data will be proportionally separated according to the distribution of classes in each set. Shuffle must be true to stratify the data.
label.useManualSplittingBySpecifyingRowIndexes: Use manual splitting by specifying the row indexes of each subset
label.usePredefinedSplitsFromDatasetNotAvailab: Use predefined splits from dataset (not available)
label.useRandomRowsBySpecifyingPortion: Use random rows by specifying which portion of the dataset you want to use for each subset
label.groupColumnDescription: Column to use for grouping. Samples belonging to the same group will be kept together in the same fold, avoiding having a group appear simultaneously in training and test.
